# Kinetic type — Style Prompt

> Words are the picture. Huge condensed words take turns in one spot on a hard beat, a colour curtain flips the frame for the subject's name, a number lands with a bounce, and the ending holds still long enough to read. Nothing else competes: one background that breathes, one ring that turns, and type doing all the work.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is a **rhythm of single words**. Each beat puts one idea on screen at the largest size that fits, so a viewer scrolling with the sound off still reads it in a glance. The hook is three or four words that enter and leave in the same masked slot, about 0.6 s apart, the last one coloured and pumped. Then the frame flips: a curtain in the main colour wipes up and the subject is stacked line by line in the background colour. The body is one number or one claim at a time; the ending is the name, a pill-shaped call to action and the contact, held.

Not a lyric video (no word-by-word captions of speech), not a slideshow of sentences (never more than seven words at once, usually one), not a logo sting (the words carry meaning, not decoration), not a template of bouncing letters (letters never move individually; whole words and lines do).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **A flat stage**: the background with one soft radial pool of the second surface behind the centre, a large blurred-looking glow of the main colour drawn as a radial gradient (no filter), and a thin dashed ring in the accent. These breathe and turn slowly for the whole film; they are the only decoration.
- **Masks everywhere**: every word sits in an `overflow: hidden` box the height of its line, so it enters by rising from below its own baseline and leaves by rising out of the top.
- **The colour curtain**: a full-frame panel in the main colour revealed with a `clip-path: inset()` wipe from the bottom, and later wiped away to the top.
- **The tape**: a band in the background colour, rotated −6°, running across the curtain with a repeating line of short words; it slides in, then its text scrolls linearly.
- **Outline words**: one word of the hook can be set as an outline (transparent fill, 5 px text stroke in the text colour) for contrast within the rhythm.
- **The pill**: the call to action as a rounded pill in the main colour.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the stage; `--latar-2`: the soft pool behind the centre.
- `--utama`: the curtain and the call-to-action pill; as `--utama-di-latar`, the hot word of the hook, the price and the tape's words (it falls back to the text colour when the brand's main colour would not read on the background). It is the one colour that means "this matters".
- `--teks-di-utama`: everything set on the curtain and the pill.
- `--teks`: words on the stage; `--teks-redup`: labels and the contact lines.
- `--aksen`: only the dashed ring. Keep it quiet.
- The curtain is the colour flip of the film: on it, the background colour becomes the tape and the text becomes `--teks-di-utama`.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries every word that matters: a tall condensed display face (Bebas Neue by default; Archivo Black or Poppins 800 also hold when the brand has them, at about 70 % of the size because they are wider). Uppercase, letter-spacing +4 to +6 px.
- `--font-isi` carries labels, the price caption and the contact: Poppins 500, sentence case.
- Sizes at 1080 wide: hook words 380 px (line box 400 px), subject lines 250 px at line-height 0.92, the price 300 px, the ending name 210 px, the pill 64 px, labels 52-60 px, contact 50 px. Nothing under 48 px.
- One word per slot in the hook; the subject in at most three lines of one to two words.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Word beat**: a word enters with `yPercent: 110 → 0` over 0.4 s `expo.out`, holds about 0.15 s, and leaves with `yPercent: 0 → −110` over 0.28 s `power2.in`; the next word starts 0.6 s after the previous one.
- **Pump**: the last hook word scales to 1.12 and back (0.25 s each way, `power2.out`, yoyo).
- **Curtain**: `clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0) → inset(0)` over 0.6 s `expo.inOut`; out the same way to the top.
- **Stacked lines**: each line rises from `yPercent: 110` over 0.6 s `expo.out`, staggered 0.12 s.
- **Tape**: slides in from `xPercent: −110` over 0.7 s `expo.out`, then its text runs linearly (about 175 px per second).
- **Number**: rises 120 px with a fade over 0.6 s `power3.out` while it counts up for 1.1 s `power2.out` (rounded to steps that read, e.g. 500), then a 1.08 pump.
- **Ending**: name 0.6 s `expo.out`, pill 0.5 s `back.out(1.8)` from 0.6, contact 0.5 s; the pill breathes (1.05, `sine.inOut`, a few times); everything holds at least 2.5 s and fades out in the last 0.5 s.
- **Background**: the glow breathes 0.85 → 1.1 over 7.5 s `sine.inOut`; the ring turns 120° over the whole film, linear.

## 6. Camera grammar

There is no camera move: the frame is fixed and the type moves. Transitions are the camera.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Masked word swap in one slot | a beat, a heartbeat, "listen" | a hook question, a list of three qualities, a countdown |
| Curtain wipe up | the reveal, the turn of the story | the product's name, the chapter title, the answer |
| Curtain wipe away to the top | moving on | back to the stage for the number or the ending |
| Rise and fade of a block | a new fact arrives | a price, a statistic, a date |
| Hold with a breathing pill | the ask | follow, order, subscribe, join |

## 7. Native moves

- **Word drumroll.** Three or four words in one masked slot, 0.6 s apart, the last one in the main colour and pumped. *Fits content like:* "BOSAN SAMA KOPI BIASA?" for a cafe's new drink; "3 KESALAHAN EDITING PEMULA" for a creator's tips video; "KENAPA LANGIT BIRU?" for a science channel; "SATU MALAM DI STASIUN" opening a short story.
- **Colour flip reveal.** The curtain wipes up and the subject stacks line by line, with a tape of short words running across. *Fits content like:* a new menu item; an episode title; the name of a course module; a book title.
- **Outline contrast.** One word of a run set as an outline among filled ones. *Fits content like:* "MURAH / BUKAN / MURAHAN"; "BELAJAR / BUKAN / MENGHAFAL".
- **Counting number.** A giant number counts up and pumps once. *Fits content like:* a price; "10.000 subscriber"; "7 hari"; "98% lulus".
- **Held ending.** Name, pill, contact; the pill breathes. *Fits content like:* "Mampir hari ini" and an address; "Follow untuk part 2"; "Daftar kelas" and a link.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Long words at 380 px overflow 920 px of safe width: keep hook words to about seven characters, or drop the size for that word (never wrap it).
- Two words entering at once kills the beat. One slot, one word.
- A wider brand font in the same box overflows: scale the sizes down instead of letting lines break.
- Text on the curtain in `--teks` instead of `--teks-di-utama` disappears on light main colours.
- Fading words in place instead of masking them looks cheap; always rise through the mask.
- The ending must hold still: no pumping text while the contact is being read, only the pill breathes.

# Kinetic type: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.4, medium 2, long 2.6.

## hook

- en: big words slam in one by one, the key word scaled up
- id: kata besar menghentak bergantian, kata kunci dibesarkan

## problem

- en: the problem word shakes, then is struck out
- id: kata masalah bergetar lalu dicoret

## fact

- en: a short statement stacked word by word
- id: pernyataan pendek disusun per kata

## step

- en: a big step number, then the step in two lines
- id: nomor langkah besar, lalu langkahnya dua baris

## compare

- en: two words face off; the loser is struck out
- id: dua kata berhadapan, yang kalah dicoret

## number

- en: a giant number counts up
- id: angka raksasa dihitung naik

## proof

- en: one word is struck and replaced
- id: satu kata dicoret, kata pengganti masuk

## offer

- en: the offer stacked word by word, colours flipped
- id: penawaran disusun per kata, warna dibalik

## cta

- en: big call to action plus a contact pill, held 2 s
- id: ajakan besar + pill kontak, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the closing line word by word, held 2 s
- id: kalimat penutup per kata, diam 2 detik

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Kinetic type</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Bebas Neue"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti nilai-nilai ini. */
      :root {
        --latar: #17110d; --latar-2: #2a1d15; --utama: #ff6b2c; --aksen: #ffc857;
        --teks: #fff4e6; --teks-redup: #cdb9a5; --teks-di-utama: #17110d;
        --teks-di-aksen: #14161a; --utama-di-latar: #ff6b2c; --aksen-di-latar: #ffc857;
        --font-judul: "Bebas Neue", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
        background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, var(--latar-2), var(--latar) 72%);
        color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .glow { position: absolute; width: 1400px; height: 1400px; left: -160px; top: 260px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 38%, transparent) 0%, transparent 62%); }
      .ring { position: absolute; width: 900px; height: 900px; left: 90px; top: 510px; border-radius: 50%;
        border: 3px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 45%, transparent); }
      /* Kata pembuka: semua di posisi yang sama, masuk dan keluar bergantian (data-layout-allow-overlap: tumpukan itu disengaja). */
      .mask { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; overflow: hidden; text-align: center; }
      .hook { top: 690px; height: 400px; }
      .w { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; display: block; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 380px;
        line-height: 400px; letter-spacing: 4px; }
      .w.outline { color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 5px var(--teks); }
      .w.hot { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      /* Adegan 2: tirai warna dan nama produk. */
      .curtain { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); }
      .kenalan { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 470px; font-size: 52px; font-weight: 500; text-align: center; }
      .nama { position: absolute; left: 60px; right: 60px; top: 580px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-judul);
        font-size: 250px; line-height: 0.92; }
      .nama .line { display: block; overflow: hidden; }
      .nama .line span { display: inline-block; }
      .tape { position: absolute; left: -200px; width: 1480px; top: 1270px; height: 130px; background: var(--latar);
        color: var(--utama-di-latar); transform: rotate(-6deg); overflow: hidden; }
      .tape .run { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 104px;
        line-height: 130px; letter-spacing: 6px; }
      /* Adegan 3: harga. */
      .harga-wrap { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 600px; text-align: center; }
      .harga-label { font-size: 60px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .harga { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 300px; line-height: 1; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .harga-sub { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 20px; }
      /* Penutup. */
      .cta { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 640px; text-align: center; }
      .cta .usaha { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 210px; line-height: 1; }
      .cta .ajak { display: inline-block; margin-top: 50px; padding: 30px 64px; border-radius: 80px;
        background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); font-size: 64px; font-weight: 800; }
      .cta .info { margin-top: 56px; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--teks-redup); }
    </style>

  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="glow" id="glow"></div>
      <div class="ring" id="ring"></div>

      <div class="mask hook" id="hook" data-role="hook">
        <span class="w" id="w1" data-layout-allow-overlap>BOSAN</span>
        <span class="w outline" id="w2" data-layout-allow-overlap>SAMA</span>
        <span class="w" id="w3" data-layout-allow-overlap>KOPI</span>
        <span class="w hot" id="w4" data-layout-allow-overlap>BIASA?</span>
      </div>

      <div class="curtain" id="curtain" data-role="offer">
        <div class="kenalan" id="kenalan">Kenalan sama menu baru kami</div>
        <div class="nama" id="nama">
          <span class="line"><span>ES KOPI</span></span>
          <span class="line"><span>GULA AREN</span></span>
          <span class="line"><span>PANDAN</span></span>
        </div>
        <div class="tape" id="tape"><div class="run" id="run">BARU • SEGAR • MANIS PAS • BARU • SEGAR • MANIS PAS • BARU • SEGAR • MANIS PAS •</div></div>
      </div>

      <div class="harga-wrap" id="harga-wrap" data-role="number">
        <div class="harga-label">Cuma</div>
        <div class="harga" id="harga">Rp18.000</div>
        <div class="harga-sub">Ukuran besar, es batu kristal</div>
      </div>

      <div class="cta" id="cta" data-role="cta">
        <div class="usaha">KOPI SENJA</div>
        <div class="ajak" id="ajak">Mampir hari ini</div>
        <div class="info"><div>Jl. Melati No. 12, Bandung</div><div>Chat 0812-3456-7890</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      // Latar yang selalu hidup: cahaya bernapas, cincin berputar pelan.
      tl.fromTo("#glow", { scale: 0.85 }, { scale: 1.1, duration: 7.5, ease: "sine.inOut", repeat: 1, yoyo: true }, 0)
        .fromTo("#ring", { rotation: 0 }, { rotation: 120, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0);

      // Pembuka: satu kata per ketukan, masuk dari bawah, keluar ke atas.
      const words = ["#w1", "#w2", "#w3", "#w4"];
      words.forEach((w, i) => {
        const t = 0.15 + i * 0.6;
        tl.fromTo(w, { yPercent: 110 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "expo.out" }, t);
        if (i < words.length - 1) tl.to(w, { yPercent: -110, duration: 0.28, ease: "power2.in" }, t + 0.42);
      });
      tl.to("#w4", { scale: 1.12, duration: 0.25, ease: "power2.out", yoyo: true, repeat: 1 }, 2.15)
        .to("#hook", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.in" }, 2.95);

      // Tirai warna menyapu dari bawah, lalu nama produk baris demi baris.
      tl.fromTo("#curtain", { clipPath: "inset(100% 0% 0% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 2.9)
        .from("#kenalan", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 3.4)
        .from("#nama .line span", { yPercent: 110, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 3.55)
        .from("#tape", { xPercent: -110, duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out" }, 4.1)
        .fromTo("#run", { x: 0 }, { x: -700, duration: 4, ease: "none" }, 4.1)
        .to("#curtain", { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 100% 0%)", duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 7.2);

      // Harga: mendarat dengan pantulan kecil, angka dihitung naik.
      const price = { v: 0 };
      const hargaEl = document.getElementById("harga");
      tl.from("#harga-wrap", { y: 120, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.out" }, 7.55)
        .to(price, {
          v: 18000, duration: 1.1, ease: "power2.out",
          onUpdate: () => { hargaEl.textContent = "Rp" + (Math.round(price.v / 500) * 500).toLocaleString("id-ID"); },
        }, 7.6)
        .to("#harga", { scale: 1.08, duration: 0.2, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power2.out" }, 8.7)
        .to("#harga-wrap", { y: -120, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.in" }, 10.4);

      // Penutup: nama usaha, ajakan, alamat; diam supaya sempat dibaca.
      tl.from("#cta .usaha", { yPercent: 60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 10.8)
        .from("#ajak", { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 11.15)
        .from("#cta .info", { y: 30, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 11.4)
        .to("#ajak", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.4, yoyo: true, repeat: 3, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 12)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

        <div class="harga-label">Cuma</div>
        <div class="harga" id="harga">Rp18.000</div>
        <div class="harga-sub">Ukuran besar, es batu kristal</div>

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      // Latar yang selalu hidup: cahaya bernapas, cincin berputar pelan.
      tl.fromTo("#glow", { scale: 0.85 }, { scale: 1.1, duration: 7.5, ease: "sine.inOut", repeat: 1, yoyo: true }, 0)
        .fromTo("#ring", { rotation: 0 }, { rotation: 120, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0);

      // Pembuka: satu kata per ketukan, masuk dari bawah, keluar ke atas.
      const words = ["#w1", "#w2", "#w3", "#w4"];
      words.forEach((w, i) => {
        const t = 0.15 + i * 0.6;
        tl.fromTo(w, { yPercent: 110 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "expo.out" }, t);
        if (i < words.length - 1) tl.to(w, { yPercent: -110, duration: 0.28, ease: "power2.in" }, t + 0.42);
      });
      tl.to("#w4", { scale: 1.12, duration: 0.25, ease: "power2.out", yoyo: true, repeat: 1 }, 2.15)
        .to("#hook", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.in" }, 2.95);

      // Tirai warna menyapu dari bawah, lalu nama produk baris demi baris.
      tl.fromTo("#curtain", { clipPath: "inset(100% 0% 0% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 2.9)
        .from("#kenalan", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 3.4)
        .from("#nama .line span", { yPercent: 110, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 3.55)
        .from("#tape", { xPercent: -110, duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out" }, 4.1)
        .fromTo("#run", { x: 0 }, { x: -1000, duration: 4, ease: "none" }, 4.1)
        .to("#curtain", { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 100% 0%)", duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 7.2);

      // Harga: mendarat dengan pantulan kecil, angka dihitung naik.
      const price = { v: 0 };
      const hargaEl = document.getElementById("harga");
      tl.from("#harga-wrap", { y: 120, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "power3.out" }, 7.55)
        .to(price, {
          v: 18000, duration: 1.1, ease: "power2.out",
          onUpdate: () => { hargaEl.textContent = "Rp" + (Math.round(price.v / 500) * 500).toLocaleString("id-ID"); },
        }, 7.6)
        .to("#harga", { scale: 1.08, duration: 0.2, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power2.out" }, 8.7)
        .to("#harga-wrap", { y: -120, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.in" }, 10.4);

      // Penutup: nama usaha, ajakan, alamat; diam supaya sempat dibaca.
      tl.from("#cta .usaha", { yPercent: 60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 10.8)
        .from("#ajak", { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 11.15)
        .from("#cta .info", { y: 30, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 11.4)
        .to("#ajak", { scale: 1.05, duration: 0.4, yoyo: true, repeat: 3, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 12)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
